content.user_title: Diagnose Ad Fatigue and Frequency Decay
content.value_statement: Scaling campaigns can hide creative fatigue behind rising frequency and mixed conversion signals. This skill compares trend data to an early baseline and recommends rotate, widen, or hold actions.
actual_capabilities: Compares current frequency, CTR, and CVR against an early-flight baseline.
Separates creative fatigue from audience saturation using reach and frequency trends.
Returns rotate creative, widen audience, or hold guidance for each ad set.
Flags conversion tracking concerns before relying on CVR decay.
Labels figures as measured, user-provided, or estimated.
limitations: Requires a daily or weekly time series to read decay reliably.
Does not create replacement ads or audience segments.
Does not compute the full account audit score or final vetoes.
Optional platform APIs are not required and are not configured by the skill.

use_cases.title: Diagnose a Scaling Prospecting Set
use_cases.description: Review frequency, CTR, CVR, and reach trends to decide whether a prospecting set needs new creative.

use_cases.title: Check Audience Saturation Before Budget Changes
use_cases.description: Use reach plateau and frequency growth to decide whether widening the audience is safer than rotating assets.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Handoff for Campaign Operators
use_cases.description: Summarize the threshold, trigger, and caveats so another operator can act on the diagnosis.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Fatigue Check
prompt_templates.scenario: You have a campaign export and need a first read.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this ad set export for fatigue. Compare frequency, CTR, CVR, and reach against the early-flight baseline.

prompt_templates.title: Rotate or Widen Decision
prompt_templates.scenario: CTR is falling and frequency is rising.
prompt_templates.prompt: Decide whether this ad set should rotate creative, widen audience, or hold. Name the threshold that fires.

prompt_templates.title: Multi Ad Set Triage
prompt_templates.scenario: You need to prioritize several active ad sets.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these ad sets and rank them by fatigue risk. Return one trigger and one caveat for each ad set.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Measurement Review
prompt_templates.scenario: CVR is falling and tracking quality is uncertain.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether the CVR drop is real or a measurement issue. Separate measured data, user-provided data, and estimates.

output_examples.input: A prospecting ad set has frequency 6.2, CTR down 48 percent, CVR stable, and reach still growing.
output_examples.output: The likely trigger is rotate creative. Frequency and CTR decay point to creative fatigue, while stable CVR reduces saturation concern.

output_examples.input: A retargeting set has reach flat for ten days, frequency rising, CTR down, and CVR down.
output_examples.output: The likely trigger is widen audience. Reach plateau and rising frequency suggest audience saturation, with conversion decay as a caveat.

output_examples.input: A new ad set has only one day of data after launch.
output_examples.output: No fatigue read is possible yet. Request a time series or the learning-exit date before assigning a trigger.

best_practices: Use a fixed early-flight baseline after the ad set exits learning.
Confirm reach behavior before naming fatigue or saturation.
Ask before saving results and keep the saved summary concise.
anti_patterns: Calling fatigue from one daily snapshot.
Using one universal frequency ceiling for every objective.
Treating a CVR drop as real without checking tracking quality.

faq.question: What data does this skill need?
faq.answer: It needs a time series with frequency, CTR, CVR, reach, spend, and the early baseline window when available.

faq.question: Can it work without CVR data?
faq.answer: Yes. It can read a CTR and frequency signal, but it will mark CVR as unavailable.

faq.question: Does it build new creative?
faq.answer: No. It diagnoses whether creative rotation is needed and points to a creative builder for production.

faq.question: Does it require ad platform API access?
faq.answer: No. The skill is designed to work from user-provided exports. APIs are optional conveniences.

faq.question: How does it separate fatigue from saturation?
faq.answer: It compares CTR, CVR, reach, and frequency trends against the baseline and names the dominant driver.

faq.question: Can it make final account audit decisions?
faq.answer: No. It flags measurement risk but does not compute final audit scores or vetoes.
